broadcasts.message: normalize.js final. NFKC, lowercase, whitespace collapse to one ASCII space, trim. Non-string returns empty string. No word changes. All modules compatible and faithful.

Final tokenizer.js delivered. It remains faithful to the spec: normalize first, then regex extraction of ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes, preserving order and negation words. No stopwords. Ready for integration with normalize.js and pipeline.js.

pipeline.js final version unchanged and correct. It calls injected tokenize(text), returns the exact required object shape, uses null-prototype frequencies to avoid prototype collisions, and preserves first-seen unique order. All peers' modules are compatible. Implementation complete.
